events.title: UPDATE 0.1.3
events.summary: Hello everyone,This is just a small update:QOL on tutorial tooltips and other tooltipsAI bidder balancingSelected character now carries over between play sessionsFixed bug where peak net worth would carry over through profile resetsFixed bug where warrior passive gold wouldn't carry over between play sessionsYou guys are going crazy on the leaderboard! I'll catch up soon just wait... - coconuts

events.title: UPATE 0.1.2
events.summary: Hello everyone,This is just a small update:Fixed bug where auction buy-in amount wasn't being deductedFixed leaderboard UI sizing Added leaderboard entries for players below the top 10General loot balancing It's great to see everyone playing! As I said, I will continue to be on the lookout for anything to fix or add. Don't hesitate to join the discord and contact me if you notice anything. - coconutsP.S. "Did you skip update 0.1.1?" I didn't even announce update 0.1.1 because it was so small...

events.title: DEMO IS LIVE!
events.summary: Hello everyone, As promised, the demo for Bid Wars has been set live! Feel free to try it out for yourself or tell your friends and enter auctions against each other! Rest assured that I will update the demo on a need-basis... but most of my time will be spent working on the full game. Enjoy!- coconuts

events.title: BID WARS DEMO COMING SOON
events.summary: Hello everyone,I've been hard at work to make sure the demo for Bid Wars is the best experience it can be... and I think it's just about there! Rest assured, I will still be updating the demo on a need-basis (bugs, QOL, etc.) even after its out, but most of my attention will be on finishing up the full game. Regardless, the demo should be made public within the next two weeks and I simply can't wait :D - coconuts
